_comment: Story campaign (scenes/story.py). Shown in campaign mode when Settings/Modes 'Story campaign' is on. briefing/debrief: [speaker, text] lines shown before/after the sector. radio: {wave number: [speaker, text]} said over the radio when that wave starts. speakers: name, color and the initials on the portrait.

briefing: Kepler Belt, 2189. Outpost Omega is the last relay station between the colonies and deep space.
Commander Vance, long-range sensors caught something burning through the upper atmosphere. Organic. Lots of it.
Meteors don't change course, Commander. These did. Twice.
Turrets are crated and ready. Point me at a spot and I'll bolt one down.
Hold the outpost. Whatever they are, they do not reach that Core.

2: They're small but there's a lot of them. Keep those Pulse Turrets fed!
5: Chitin, six legs, no tools. Animals... or very good at looking like animals.
10: Big signal coming up the canyon. Everybody brace.

debrief: I ran tissue samples from the wreckage. These creatures were grown, not born. Same genome, all of them.
Their trail leads north. Toward the ice fields.

briefing: The northern relay is our only line to the fleet. If it goes dark, so do we.
Ice is murder on the treads. Watch your footing out there, Commander.
Get the Cryo Towers up first. Anything that freezes, dies slower.

3: Fliers! Gliders over the ridge, get something that shoots up!
6: Relay signal strong. Fleet Command is listening, Commander. Make it count.

debrief: Message received. The fleet is mobilising, but they're weeks out.
I found something odd in the relay logs. A ship came down in the canyon a month ago. Nobody reported it.

briefing: That's no crash. Look at the impact pattern. It landed. Gently.
A nursery. And it's still warm.
Then let's go turn the lights off.

4: Brood Sacs! Kill them fast or they split into Skitters.
10: Something huge just woke up in that pod.

debrief: The Overseer was directing the others. Not with sound... with pheromone pulses. A chain of command.
Then there's someone at the top of that chain.
Heat signatures moving south. Toward the old forge.

briefing: The forge is ours. Old mining rig, still hot. The bugs want it for something.
They're cold-blooded. The magma vents would let them breed year-round.
Then they don't get it. Patch, can you overclock anything in there?
Give me a wave or two and some scrap. I'll make it sing.

3: Vents are spiking! Mind the towers, they're running hot.

debrief: Forge is cooling. Good news: I salvaged enough parts for better turrets.
Bad news: the swarm is massing on the plains. Biggest group we've seen.

briefing: No canyons, no choke points. Just grass and a lot of teeth.
Fleet's been delayed. There's a storm in the jump lanes. You'll have to hold on your own a while longer.
Open ground means we build the walls. Barricades are loaded.

2: Make them walk the long way. Every step is another shot.
6: They're changing formation. They watched what we did last time.
10: Here comes the big one! Everything you've got!

debrief: They adapt between fights. Something remembers, and teaches.
Orbital Platform Six just went quiet. Find out why.

briefing: Conveyor belts everywhere. Keep your boots planted, Commander.
Platform Six controls the orbital strike array. If the swarm has it, nobody is safe.
Then we take it back. Quietly, if we can.

4: Shield Drones are covering the bigger ones. Pick off the drones first.
8: Orbital array is back online. Use it well, Commander.

debrief: The platform's sensors caught a signal under all the noise. Structured. Repeating.
An answer. Coming from an old ship parked in high orbit. Our ship.

briefing: The UES Meridian vanished on a survey run twelve years ago. It is not supposed to be here.
No power, no lights. Radar Relays will help you see them coming.

3: I'm in the captain's log. 'First contact. Specimens are... intelligent. They are learning from us.'
6: Last entry: 'Captain Hale has gone below. He says they want to talk.'
10: Movement in the dark. A lot of it.

debrief: The hive didn't find us by accident. The Meridian brought it here. It studied the crew.
Twelve years of studying us. God help us.
Two reactors on the lower deck are lighting up. They're going after both at once.

briefing: Two Cores, two problems. Lose either one and the whole station's gone.
Split the defenses. Don't leave either side naked.
They've never attacked two targets before. They're testing us.

4: Pressure on the east core! Shift some fire!

debrief: Good work. The pattern is clear now: the hive is spreading signal nodes across the system.
The jungle moon. It wasn't a jungle a year ago.

briefing: They terraformed it. A whole moon, overgrown in a year. Those vines will choke our turrets.
Walk up to an overgrown tower and I'll cut it loose.

3: Vines on the east turrets! Commander, get over there!
7: The Swarm Mind is linking them. Break the link and they scatter.

debrief: The Hive Mind was a relay, not the source. It was passing orders along.
The crystal caves. They're amplifying the signal like an antenna.

briefing: Listen. The crystals hum when the signal passes through them.
Beam towers next to crystals hit harder. Lasers, Lances, Ion. Use 'em.
The bugs use them too. Watch where they pop out.

4: Reflectors! Don't waste lasers on those.
8: Something big in the acid pools. Very big.

debrief: ...WE HEAR YOU, LITTLE COMMANDER. WE HAVE ALWAYS HEARD YOU.
WE ARE WHAT YOUR CAPTAIN HALE BECAME. COME TO THE CITY. SEE.

briefing: It's a trap. You know it's a trap.
Yes. But if Hale is still in there, I need to know.
There's a gate on the shortcut through the city. Stand on the switch to close it and make them go around.

3: Jammers: they cut your abilities when they get close. Keep them away from you.
6: YOUR CAPTAIN FOUGHT TOO. WE KEPT WHAT WAS USEFUL.

debrief: It wasn't him anymore. Just his tactics, wearing his face.
The fleet has dropped out of the jump lanes. We're coming in over the gas giant. Hold the station until we arrive.

briefing: Low gravity. Shells fly further, and so do you. Don't float off.
The hive is sending everything at the gas station to stop our fleet from refueling.

3: Bombers! They're going for the towers, not the core!
7: Fleet is in orbit. We just need the station a little longer.

debrief: Fleet is refueled. And with the station's sensors we finally triangulated the signal.
It's the Hive Heart. Buried under the moon's crust. Everything comes from there.
Then that's where we end it.

briefing: Beneath the moon's crust, the hive has built a cathedral of living stone.
The fleet will bombard the Heart once its defenses are down. Your outpost is the anchor, Commander. If it falls, we lose the beacon.
Two tunnels, both full of everything they've ever thrown at us. And then some.
YOU CANNOT WIN, COMMANDER. WE REWRITE THE GROUND YOU STAND ON.
Then I'll keep building. Every time.

3: Both tunnels are active. Split your firepower.
6: The Queen's guarding the tunnel. Bring her down!
9: Ammo's low, morale's high. Keep going!
12: WE ARE THE PATH. WE ARE THE WALL. WE ARE...

ending: The bombardment lasted eleven hours. When the dust settled, the signal was gone.
Without the Heart, the remaining swarms are just animals again. Scattered. Lost.
Guess I'll need a new hobby. Maybe gardening. Not jungle gardening.
Commander Vance, the colonies owe you everything. Outpost Omega stands.
It stands because people stood with it. Somebody put the kettle on.
THE END.  Thank you for playing Outpost Omega: Alien Siege.
